# LEOVRA CLOTHES

> Modern minimalist streetwear, heavyweight combed cotton oversized tees, wide-leg track pants, and everyday casual essentials engineered for comfort, style, and movement.

Leovra Clothes (Leovra Enterprises) is an Indian direct-to-consumer apparel brand offering premium heavyweight cotton t-shirts, wide-leg track pants, relaxed bottom-wear, and casual fashion with nationwide express delivery across India.

## Store Information
- Website: https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/
- Currency: Indian Rupee (INR / ₹)
- Payment Methods: Instant UPI QR (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM), Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD)
- Shipping: Free delivery on all prepaid/UPI orders; flat ₹99 for Cash on Delivery
- Return Policy: 7-day hassle-free return and exchange guarantee from delivery date
- Customer Support: care@leovraclothes.com / +91 79799 68347
- Support Hours: Mon - Sat: 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM IST

## Primary Collections
- [All Products](https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/#catalog): Complete apparel and accessories catalog
- [New Arrivals](https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/?category=new): Fresh streetwear drops, seasonal colorways, and new cuts
- [Best Sellers](https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/?category=bestsellers): Customer-favorite track pants and signature oversized tees
- [Men's T-Shirts](https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/?category=mens_tshirts): Heavyweight combed cotton, minimal graphics, relaxed drop-shoulder fits
- [Women's T-Shirts](https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/?category=womens_tshirts): Cropped and relaxed streetwear tees
- [Men's Lowers](https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/?category=mens_lowers): Wide-leg track pants, cargo joggers, and comfort bottom-wear
- [Women's Lowers](https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/?category=womens_lowers): Parachute pants, wide-leg sweatpants, and everyday trousers

## Featured Products
- [Step Out Red Wide-Leg Track Pants](https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/?product=step-out-red): Wide-leg track pants engineered with contrast black vertical side panels, adjustable drawstring waist, breathable lightweight nylon blend fabric, and relaxed streetwear drape.
- [Everyday Comfort Beige Track Pants](https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/?product=comfort-beige): Neutral beige relaxed-fit bottom-wear featuring clean white side piping, ultra-soft feel, and all-day comfort.
- [Heavyweight Oversized Streetwear Tee](https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/?product=heavyweight-tee): 240 GSM pre-shrunk combed cotton t-shirt with reinforced ribbed collar and dropped shoulder silhouette.

- [Order Tracking](https://loevraenterprises.publicvm.com/?action=track): Real-time shipment status lookup by order reference number
